name: Notesnook
description_en:
Notesnook is an open-source note application centred on end-to-end encrypted personal notes and cross-device sync. It documents a rich editor, linked notes, notebooks, attachments, web clipping, optional published notes and reminders. Client and server source availability is distinct from the limits of the vendor-hosted service.

The current free offer includes unlimited notes and devices, with attachment allowances rather than a note-count paywall. Recovery deserves particular attention because the documented encryption model prevents staff from simply retrieving readable notes for a user.
description_zh:
Notesnook 是以端到端加密个人笔记与跨设备同步为核心的开源笔记应用，文档列有富文本编辑、笔记关联、笔记本、附件、网页采集、可选笔记发布与提醒。客户端／服务端源码可用，与厂商托管服务的额度是两回事。

当前免费方案不限制笔记与设备，主要通过附件额度区分，而非按笔记数量收费。恢复尤其需要关注，因为文档中的加密模型不允许员工直接为用户找回可读笔记。

core_features.explanation_en: The vendor documents encryption before notes leave the device.
core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商文档说明笔记离开设备前进行加密。

core_features.explanation_en: Tables, tasks, attachments and bidirectional note context are documented.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档提供表格、任务、附件及双向笔记上下文。

core_features.explanation_en: Publish a selected note as a Monograph with optional password protection.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可把选中笔记发布为 Monograph，并可选择密码保护。

en: Keep a private cross-device research journal with linked sources.
zh: 维护关联来源的私密跨设备研究日志。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor sync and multi-platform clients; self-hosting advertised but current operational readiness unverified.
Deployment.zh: 厂商同步与多平台客户端；宣传可自行托管，但当前运行就绪性未核实。

steps.en: Create a test account and a linked note with an attachment within the plan limit.
steps.zh: 创建测试账户，写关联笔记并加入限额内附件。

steps.en: Review recovery-key and backup documentation before storing irreplaceable notes.
steps.zh: 保存不可替代笔记前，阅读恢复密钥与备份说明。

steps.en: Verify sync and a recipient view separately, particularly for published Monographs.
steps.zh: 分别核对同步与接收者视图，尤其是已发布 Monograph。

items.en: The official help says notes are encrypted before leaving the device and the vendor cannot recover readable notes for the user. Keep a recovery key and a representative export/backup outside the working device, then test restoration with non-sensitive data. The source licence read is GPLv3. Pricing advertises a self-hostable sync server while the homepage roadmap still labels self-hosting work in progress; production readiness and operating steps therefore need separate verification. No sync server, account recovery or encryption implementation was tested here.
items.zh: 官方帮助说明笔记离开设备前已加密，厂商无法为用户恢复可读内容。建议把恢复密钥与代表性导出／备份保存在工作设备之外，再用非敏感资料测试恢复。读取的源码许可为 GPLv3。定价页宣传同步服务可自行托管，但首页路线图仍将自行托管标为进行中，因此生产就绪程度及操作步骤需单独验证。本次未测试同步服务、账户恢复或加密实现。

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_zh: 私密采集，主动选择发布
sections.en: For an illustrative research journal, create notebooks, clip references, write linked notes and attach supporting files within the selected allowance. A published Monograph is a separate sharing action and can optionally be password protected. Do not assume that publishing one note keeps that note within the same private-account access boundary. Inspect the recipient view before sharing real private material. The described editor includes tables, tasks, code and maths rather than plain text only.
sections.zh: 例如研究日志可创建笔记本、采集参考、写关联笔记，并在套餐额度内加入附件。发布 Monograph 是单独共享动作，可选择密码保护。不能默认已发布笔记仍受私密账户同样的访问边界保护。共享真实私密资料前，应检查接收者视图。文档中的编辑器包括表格、任务、代码与数学内容，不限于纯文字。

sections.en: The free plan lists unlimited notes/devices, 50 MB attachment storage per month and a 10 MB file limit. Essential lists 1 GB/month and 100 MB files; Pro 10 GB/month and 1 GB files; Believer 25 GB/month and 5 GB files. Preserve the per-month wording instead of describing these as a permanent total storage pool. Cancellation documentation says written notes remain readable, editable and exportable on Free.
sections.zh: 免费方案列出不限笔记／设备、每月 50 MB 附件存储及单文件 10 MB。Essential 为每月 1 GB、单文件 100 MB；Pro 每月 10 GB、单文件 1 GB；Believer 每月 25 GB、单文件 5 GB。应保留“每月”单位，不能写成永久总存储池。取消说明表示已写笔记在 Free 上仍可读、编辑和导出。

sections.title_en: A regional snapshot and optional paid trials
sections.title_zh: 地区价格快照与可选付费试用
sections.en: The retrieved page localised prices to tax-inclusive SGD: Essential SGD2.77 monthly or SGD27.86 yearly; Pro SGD9.74 monthly or SGD97.53 yearly. These are regional snapshots, not USD or universal prices. Monthly/yearly trials last 14 days and require a payment method; the prepaid five-year offer has no trial. Ongoing Free requires no card and has no trial clock. Store purchases and web/desktop purchases use different payment providers.
sections.zh: 读取页面将金额本地化为含税新加坡元：Essential 按月 SGD2.77 或年费 SGD27.86；Pro 按月 SGD9.74 或年费 SGD97.53。这是地区快照，不能当作美元或通用价格。按月／按年付费试用为 14 天，需要付款方式；预付五年方案不提供试用。持续 Free 无需信用卡，也无试用倒计时。商店购买与 Web／桌面购买使用不同付款渠道。

Pricing advertises a self-hostable sync server while the homepage roadmap still labels self-hosting work in progress; production readiness and operating steps therefore need separate verification. No sync server, account recovery or encryption implementation was tested here.

research_gaps.en: Self-host production readiness, recovery-key handling, encrypted backup restore, publication permissions and cryptographic implementation were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试自行托管生产就绪性、恢复密钥处理、加密备份恢复、发布权限或密码学实现。
